title: Evaluating Demographic Data to Improve Confidence in Equity Analytics in a Children's Hospital.
ehr_evidence: Before we assessed any analyses or revision of analyst procedures, it was necessary to understand how we collect the data in Epic (Epic Systems, Verona, WI), ACH’s electronic health record (EHR).
summary: Evaluation of demographic data collection, standardization, and visualization across multiple reporting tools at a children's hospital to improve health equity analytics.
key_findings: Race 2 was missing in 95% of EDW universe encounters.
Payer data was missing in 28% of appointment universe encounters.
Including null values significantly altered the distribution of race categories across all reporting tools.
population: Pediatric patients and encounters at Akron Children's Hospital, Ohio (January 1, 2021 to June 30, 2021)
limitations: Tools and technical infrastructure may be unique to ACH
Upstream data collection accuracy was not fully assessed
